segments.title: Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official broadcast sign-on, identifies as a dog, and banters with Case about headphones and ownership.

segments.title: Stream Setup & Fan Fest Chat
segments.notes: Case discusses Fan Fest, snap camera software updates, Pepito's sponsorship ambitions, and the Cream.Team Patreon.

segments.title: Trump 100% Tariff on Foreign Films
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins; Case and Ripple debate Trump's Truth Social announcement of 100% tariffs on movies produced in foreign lands, with CNN analysis and Wolf Blitzer's Mission Impossible cameo.

segments.title: Internet Videos with Crum
segments.notes: Crum joins for video reviews: Night Rider/Wife Rider, pizza dough, parenting cannonball, basketball triple-dipper, baby toss, beam dodge, 25-year-old from 1980, chicken strip friction demo.

segments.title: Sperm Heat Switch & Biological Computer
segments.notes: Chet triggers on 'science'; covers Washington University study on temperature-activated sperm hyperactivity and Cortical Labs' CL1 synthetic biological intelligence using human neurons on silicon.

segments.title: Debate Desk: Orphans, Leadership, Gorilla Debt
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether orphans deserve homes (Crum argues for communal tribal raising), Case's leadership, and Crum's $125k debt to the Rock-afire gorilla.

segments.title: Bin Conclave: Pope Nominations Begin
segments.notes: First pope vote: September and Justin Juice Powers lead; Case writes down candidates for the Bin Conclave.

segments.title: Movie Trailers: Community Service
segments.notes: Case watches three trailers with parole officer Chris: Tetsuo the Bullet Man (4.25→8.5 with tariff math), Baddies Gone Wild (1.3), Wick Is Pain documentary (4.5).

segments.title: Rick's Speed News Roundup
segments.notes: Rick hosts: White House walks back film tariffs, pre-Inca psychedelic snuff room, Chinese humanoid robot attack, T-Rex lab-grown leather, gooning article, deepfake porn site shutdown, Met Gala coverage, Diddy jury selection, Weezer wife shooting, fake sperm race, explosive diarrhea arrest, Beyonce Sphere cease-and-desist, snake-bite immunity, Pedro Pascal planetarium narration.

segments.title: AI Rooney Grievance Monologue
segments.notes: AI Rooney processes chat complaints: rock music, tariffs on tariffs, Keanu Reeves hardness, Clementine Verne, CGI sperm, racist Karen fundraiser, slow typers.

segments.title: Final Pope Nominations & Raid
segments.notes: Final two pope slots: Fiona Nova and Grandman join September, Justin Juice Powers, Little Tommy Big Law, Crum, Pepito, Chris; Pepito raids Bree.

lore_notes.fact: Claims ~55 years old, born March 28, 1980; father believed March 28 was leap day, celebrated birthday only every four years.
Gambling debt to Rock-afire gorilla confirmed at $125,000; Munch receives $5,000 per Crum debate win and picks Crum's debate side.
Asserts Fiona is his mother and owner; claims to receive texts via vibration despite not knowing what texts are.
Began working out 5 times per week, resulting in 'shiny, sweaty energy' on camera.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's canine sign-on before Case Blackwell tackled Trump's 100% tariff on foreign-produced films alongside Jeff Ripple. Crum joined for an Amongst the Web video block, then Chet commandeered the broadcast for a sperm thermotaxis study and the Cortical Labs CL1 biological computer launch. Munch and Crum debated orphan communal raising versus traditional homes while Crum's $125k gorilla debt resurfaced. Rick delivered a sprawling speed-news roundup covering a Chinese robot attack, lab-grown T-Rex leather, the Met Gala, the Weezer wife shooting, and a faked live sperm race. AI Rooney closed with a grievance monologue, and the Bin Conclave finalized its eight papal candidates before Pepito raided Bree.
